page.layout: Two printed pages on one scan. Left page: faint show-through and a faint running head at the top, a blank middle, a centred heading "INDICIS" with a woodcut ornament below. Right page: cropped at the edge, showing a title block with ornaments, a large initial at the lower part and short lines of text, most of them cut off.
page.notes: Left page: the upper block of faint small type looks like show-through from the reverse, so I have not transcribed it. The top faint word may be a running head, which I cannot read with confidence. The large heading reads "INDICIS" clearly. The first word is unreadable and may be "TRIBVS" or "TITVLI" (uncertain). Below the heading is a woodcut ornament with no text. Right page: a title block of ornament and capitals ("E", "LEG", "CAR", "INQVA C...") is cut off at the scan edge, and the small italic lines beside it are too cropped to read. The right-hand lines in the lower part are also cropped at the edge. None of these lines can be read reliably.
